layers.title: Top edge of the screen
layers.description: The notch hangs from the top edge and flares into it at both corners.

layers.title: Host
layers.description: Owns the shape, the padding and the header. 136 px tall: 10 + 16 + 10 + 86 + 14.

layers.title: Header, 16 px
layers.description: One row drawn by the host, the same on every page.

layers.title: Page dots
layers.description: One pill for the current page and a dot for each other page.

layers.title: Clock
layers.description: Sits in the centre of the header.

layers.title: Status icons
layers.description: Activities such as volume, microphone and camera show here.

layers.title: Settings
layers.description: Opens the settings window, which is a separate program.

layers.title: The page, 86 px
layers.description: Only this area belongs to the page. Its width sets the width of the pill.

layers.title: Cover art
layers.description: Album art from the playing app, with that app's badge on the corner.

layers.title: Controls
layers.description: Previous, pause, next, and the lyrics toggle.
